mechanism: Torsemide-induced volume depletion and reduced glomerular filtration rate may impair fosfomycin renal elimination and increase antibiotic exposure, while fosfomycin nephrotoxicity risk is elevated in dehydrated patients.
action: Monitor renal function and urine output closely; ensure adequate hydration; adjust fosfomycin dosing if renal impairment develops; consider alternative antibiotic if possible in patients on loop diuretics.
